notes: Berean CE: Powder-X Rev 1 hopper access hardware (caged ladder, service platform, handrails) is not verified complete OSHA fall protection; a cage is not a ladder safety system (29 CFR 1910.21); platforms at 4 ft or more need a guardrail system (1910.28(b)(1), 1910.29(b)); climbs over 24 ft need a ladder safety system or personal fall arrest system (1910.28(b)(9)).
